subject: Payment arrangement and VAT evidence for pilot invoices
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medsynergy.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-11 13:12:00 +0000
Subject: Payment arrangement and VAT evidence for pilot invoices

Hi Diego / Lauren,

Thanks again for the pilot run last week — the model performance looks promising. Procurement here has two requests before they can approve our first scheduled payment run:

1) We usually operate on Net60 for new vendor relationships; given you asked for earlier consumption we want to propose Net45 for the pilot period (two invoices), then reassess and move to Net30 on steady-state.
2) Our finance team requires documented VAT registration / tax residence evidence from Redwood for cross-border invoice processing. They asked for either a VAT certificate or a letter from your tax counsel.
3) Given the pilot cashflow, would Redwood consider a small escrow holdback (8% of each invoice) released after tax evidence is delivered and validation completed?

If we can agree on the above and get an amended SOW, procurement will push the first invoice through the payment run scheduled Oct 25. Attached is our standard PO and a sample invoice template for your reference.

Att: invoice_template_sample.xlsx (stub)

Can we set a quick call tomorrow to close?

Best,
Elena Rossi
Head of Procurement, MedSynergy Health
elena.rossi@medsynergy.com
+44 20 7946 0XXX
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medsynergy.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-11 16:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Payment arrangement and VAT evidence for pilot invoices

Elena — thanks for the clear ask and context. I'm happy to propose a middle path that addresses procurement's controls while keeping our cash cadence reasonable for Redwood during the pilot. High-level proposal: 

- Payment schedule: First pilot invoice paid Net30 for 60% of the billed amount (acceleration to help you move quickly), remainder 40% on Net45. Second pilot invoice reverts to Net45 split 50/50 (first tranche within 30 days of invoice, remainder on day 45). After pilot completion and validation, switch to Net30.
- Escrow/holdback: We can accept an 8% provisional holdback per invoice that will be released within 7 business days after Redwood provides VAT/tax evidence and MedSynergy confirms validation.
- VAT evidence: I can share Redwood's EU VAT registration certificate and a short attestation from our finance team; targeting delivery by EOD Oct 13.
- Amended SOW: I'll draft an SOW addendum capturing the split-remit and holdback; Lauren will own the SOW edits.

Would you be okay with the above? If yes, I'll copy Marissa in for a quick credit check and have Lauren circulate the SOW draft for signature. 

Att: amended_sow_draft.docx (stub)

Thanks —
Diego Fernandez
Director, Commercial Partnerships | Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwood.com
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medsynergy.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Luca Bianchi <luca.bianchi@medsynergy.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-12 09:21:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Payment arrangement and VAT evidence for pilot invoices

Diego — that sounds reasonable and closer to what procurement will accept. A few clarifications from our side after a quick sync with Luca (cc'd, CFO):

- For the first invoice, can we make the initial 60% tranche due Net30 from invoice date and the remaining 40% due Net45? Luca prefers a clear due-date split rather than a percentage-within-dates phrasing.
- Escrow: 8% holdback is acceptable; we will release within 10 business days after receiving your VAT certificate and completed tax residency attestation (our GRC team needs the paper trail).
- Credit and limit: to enable the accelerated first tranche we will need Redwood to confirm an interim credit cap of €125k for the first 90 days. If you can confirm, we will process invoice_202610 (attached) in the Oct 25 run.

I have attached the draft invoice for your ops team's review. Also linking our procurement doc: https://procurement.medsynergy.com/po/PO-78433 (internal).

Att: invoice_202610.pdf (stub)

If you confirm the credit cap and VAT docs timeline I'll route for signature today.

Thanks,
Elena
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medsynergy.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-13 18:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Payment arrangement and VAT evidence for pilot invoices

Elena / Luca — thanks, confirmed. Quick bullets / next steps so everyone has alignment:

- Credit cap: Redwood confirms interim credit cap of €125,000 for the pilot period (90 days). Marissa, copying you to kick off a light credit validation and confirm accounting holds.
- Payment split: First invoice — 60% due Net30, 40% due Net45 (dates calculated from invoice date). Second invoice — split 50/50 (Net30 / Net45). After pilot, we will move to Net30 as discussed.
- Escrow: 8% holdback per invoice; Redwood to release within 7 business days after we provide VAT certificate and the signed tax attestation.
- VAT evidence: attaching the VAT certificate and tax attestation now. Att: tax_vat_certificate.pdf (stub).
- SOW: Lauren to publish an SOW addendum (amended_sow_draft.docx) for electronic signature; please sign-positive on DocuSign link when you get it.

If that matches, Elena — please confirm and I will get Marissa to send a short confirmation email once the credit validation completes (should be <48 hours).

Best regards,
Diego
